summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) on 2026-10-07 containing its routine third quarter 2026 update note, not a special situation. The disclosure sets Q3 guidance ranges for Integrated Gas, Upstream, Marketing, Chemicals and Products, Renewables and Energy Solutions, and Corporate, plus CFFO, net debt and margin assumptions. It notes the ARC Resources acquisition completed 2026-09-02, expected biogas impairments offset by an Integrated Gas reversal, and a ~$2.5 billion German BEHG certificate payment timing outflow. Q3 results are scheduled for 2026-10-29.
